events.context:
ROM

...

As similar threats spill across national borders via hijacked email accounts and anonymous networks, European authorities face mounting pressure in identifying those responsible.

Though it remains unclear who is behind the threats hitting France, Spain, and other nations, European officials call them a coordinated effort to sow continent-wide confusion.

...

The origins of the threats, however, remain unclear. An email sent to Italian schools was signed by a purported figure named "Mikhail Andropov," who also claimed responsibility for threats against newsrooms in Ireland and Bulgaria.

But the sender's identity remains unknown, and investigators have yet to establish whether the messages were linked to the threats against European flights. Authorities have not attributed the incidents to any group or state actor.

The threats could have been copycat incidents triggered by an initial alert, repeated actions by an individual or group, or hybrid warfare operations by state actors or their supporters, among several possible explanations outlined by Matthew Borie, co-founder and chief intelligence officer of Osprey Flight Solutions, which advises airlines on flight threats.

events.title: Labor Inspectorate complaints rose by a third due to artificial intelligence | Reflect.ee - International
events.summary: In Estonia, the Labor Inspectorate’s workload increased after AI tools made filing complaints easier. About 500 additional complaints were filed in ten months, bringing total complaints to nearly 2,600 across eight labor dispute commissions.
events.context:
Artificial intelligence has made filing complaints easier, but the Labor Inspectorate's workload has grown rapidly, and forging evidence has also become easier.

Key Facts

In ten months, the number of complaints grew by about a third

About 500 complaints were added

Almost 2,600 complaints are coming to eight commissions

Foreigners make up about a quarter of all complaints

Labor Inspectorate legal adviser Olena Smolska said during a live broadcast on Rus.Postimees that artificial intelligence has sharply increased the inspectorate's workload. In ten months, the number of complaints grew by a third, adding about 500 complaints.

Eight labor dispute committees are now facing almost 2,600 complaints. The number of committee members has not changed.

Artificial intelligence makes filing complaints easier, especially for foreigners who do not speak Estonian. They account for about a quarter of all complaints. However, texts drafted with the help of a machine are often huge and incoherent, sometimes 50 pages long, and complainants themselves often do not read them. Smolska gave an example: a paragraph describing how to treat a cat suddenly appeared in a labor dispute complaint.
events.headline: Estonia's Labour Inspectorate got about 500 extra complaints in ten months, blamed on AI tools

rel_facts.note: Complaints to a labour inspectorate are regulator-style public-body submissions, but the same tool-driven wave is not reported in the UK.

events.summary: In Lithuania, Ombudswoman Erika Leonaitė told the Seimas that a sharp rise in AI-assisted complaints is a new challenge for her office.
events.context:
Erika Leonaitė, nominated for a second five-year term as Lithuania’s parliamentary ombudswoman, says the rapid rise in complaints prepared with artificial intelligence tools is a key challenge. LRT reported, citing BNS.

“Using artificial intelligence itself is certainly not a problem,” Leonaitė told the Seimas, Lithuania’s parliament, on Tuesday. But she said the tools can make it easy to generate large numbers of repetitive or minor complaints.

Devoting a disproportionate share of resources to such complaints could harm other people’s right to good administration, she said, particularly those who are less persistent or less vocal.

...

Leonaitė has held the post since 2021. She said her office had handled about 5,500 complaints over the past five years, examining about 900 on their merits and helping resolve around 3,000 cases through

...

She said common problems included formulaic responses from institutions, people being sent between different agencies and missed statutory deadlines. ... , officials were reluctant to take responsibility for resolving a problem, while cooperation between institutions existed in rules and procedures but not in daily practice, she said.

Appunto clog (AI), letteralmente intasamento da IA, un sovraccarico continuo di testi generati con l’intelligenza artificiale all’interno delle caselle di posta adibite alla ricezione di reclami o segnalazioni pubbliche.

...

Stando ad una recente inchiesta firmata Guardian, nel Regno Unito aziende, comuni, tribunali e istituti scolastici segnalano di non riuscire più a stare dietro a questo nuovo carico di

...

Sempre il quotidiano britannico segnala che nel Regno Unito si sta valutando l’introduzione di misure anti AI-clog, ad esempio ticket/commissioni per la presentazione delle istanze o il blocco dei bot sui siti governativi.

events.context: … noise. And it means reporting the news without turning it into a scoreboard. Then there’s the golden rule of every stress test: start where it costs the least. An airport has bomb squads, protocols and fighter jets ready within ten minutes. A company with ten employees has an info@ address and someone who opens everything. For the attacker, these are just two lines on the same spreadsheet: the first is the target, the second is the means of reaching it. The same logic applies to countries. San Marino sits outside the European coordination network, which brings together EU member states, yet it has schools, public offices and a broadcaster with addresses published online just like anyone else. On the other hand, it’s small enough to decide things in ten minutes: a single number to call, a single assessment, a single voice speaking. All it needs is a direct line to those in Italy who are seeing the same emails at the same moment, and a bit of discipline — because here, a rumor can spread across Facebook groups before anyone has even opened their inbox. There are two ways to be small: someone else’s testing ground, or the place where the test fails. Better to decide which one before …

DUBLIN — Bomb threats targeting several of Ireland’s top media organizations are almost certainly linked to next week’s European Political Community summit in Dublin, a government official told POLITICO.

Newsrooms at Irish national broadcaster RTÉ, Virgin Media TV, the Irish Independent newspaper and Newstalk radio received identically worded emails Friday morning claiming bombs had been left inside their offices. 

Three of the newsrooms were evacuated, disrupting RTÉ and Newstalk programs, while Virgin staff kept broadcasts running. Police confirmed they found no suspicious devices.

“We have expected a rise in hybrid threats to Ireland because of our hosting of the EU presidency, and the EPC meeting will be by far the biggest set-piece event of that presidency, so one must presume it’s no coincidence that we’re experiencing this spike in hybrid activity now,” the Irish

...

The Irish government said the threats against media outlets were probably part of a European-wide pattern of threats that have targeted dozens of airlines this week, including Irish carriers Ryanair and Aer Lingus. Hackers also targeted supermarket refrigeration systems in at least seven European countries.
events.headline: Four Irish newsrooms received identical bomb-threat emails; three were evacuated

events.quote: A fairly large factor that is increasing not only the number of applications but also their length is AI — we are simply drowning in applications
events.title: Surge in labor disputes overwhelms Labor Inspectorate | News | ERR
events.summary: A surge in labor disputes is overwhelming Estonia’s Labor Inspectorate (Tööinspektsioon). In the first 10 months of the year, 2,593 disputes were filed (vs.
events.context:
The Labor Inspectorate (Tööinspekstioon) has eight chairs of labor dispute committees — the same number it has had for at least a decade — and 2,593 disputes have been filed in the first 10 months of this year, against 1,516 in the same period of 2022.

...

Saarep noted there are several reasons for the increase in both the number ... Redundancy disputes have grown as the economic situation has become uncertain. Disputes involving third-country (non-EU/EEA) nationals account for nearly a quarter of all cases.

...

Furthermore, the growing use of artificial intelligence (AI) has been placing an increasing burden on the system. "A fairly large factor that is increasing not only the number of applications but also their length is AI — we are simply drowning in applications," Saarep said.

A typical application fits on a couple of pages. Documents prepared using AI tend to be far longer than the norm. "A normal application involving a couple of claims could fit on one or two A4 pages, but in reality, we are seeing applications that are 50, 60, 70, 80 or even 100 pages long, sometimes more than 100 pages. All that material physically has to be read before the hearing," Saarep said.
events.headline: Estonia's Labour Inspectorate overwhelmed by a surge in disputes, partly blamed on AI

## In France, increases without measuring the share of AI

In the documents consulted by ActuIA on their 2025 activity, neither the Council of State, nor the Commission for Access to Administrative Documents (CADA), nor the CNIL (France's data protection authority) quantifies the share of requests written with AI. Volumes are rising. Administrative courts recorded 334,706 cases in 2025, 20% more than in 2024, and their backlog grew by 21.7%, according to the 2025 public report of the Council of State. In its editorial, Didier-Roland Tabuteau, then vice-president of the Council of State, wrote that AI "risks further increasing its workload by facilitating the multiplication of requests". ActuIA has detailed these signals, including two orders from the Grenoble administrative court targeting requests written by AI.

Outside the courts, CADA received 14,721 referrals in 2025, according to Acteurs publics, which consulted its activity report. That is 45% more than the average of the previous four years and more than double 2020. ... According to Acteurs publics, the report does not attribute this increase to AI. The CNIL received 20,150 complaints in 2025, compared with 17,772 in 2024.

È quanto accaduto lunedì scorso all’Istituto Comprensivo 4 di Chieti, raggiunto da una mail di allarme bomba, la stessa che ha colpito decine di scuole in tutta Italia. Il medesimo schema si è ripetuto a Verona, Arezzo, Frosinone, Arzignano. Evacuare precauzionalmente è stato, infatti, un atto di responsabilità, rispettoso dei piani di emergenza. Le critiche strumentali alla scuola sarebbero sbagliate. Il problema, invece, a nostro avviso, è un altro ossia la gestione istituzionale della comunicazione nell’emergenza”. A sottolinearlo è il gruppo Lega al Comune di Chieti, che chiede chiarezza sui protocolli, un sistema di allerta rapido e maggiori iniziative di prevenzione.

A preliminary criminal inquiry into a 51-year-old Tampere man suspected of attempted extortion after more than 100 complaints and appeals over municipal plots has been completed and sent to prosecutors, YLE reports. 

A preliminary criminal inquiry in Central Finland into a 51-year-old Tampere man suspected of attempted extortion has been completed, YLE reports.

The city filed a complaint late last year. It followed more than 100 correction requests and dozens of appeals to the administrative court over municipal plot reservations. He won a plot in a lottery, but a property manager decided not to reserve it for him. He has also sought over €150,000 in damages and lodged complaints against officials.

Detective Chief Inspector Sami Suhonen said the suspected offence is connected to the complaints and their handling; he declined to identify any alleged targets. The matter now moves to prosecutors for consideration of charges. YLE is not publishing the man’s name because he is a private individual. Earlier reporting said the appeals had delayed some projects earlier coverage.

events.summary: Swiss courts in several Swiss cities (Zurich, Bern, Aarau, Lucerne, Basel-Stadt) report a surge of long, AI‑drafted submissions from lay litigants.
events.context:
Courts across Switzerland are receiving a growing volume of long, AI-drafted legal submissions, especially from people representing themselves, according to a survey of several courts by 20 Minuten published on 16 October. Judges say the texts often sound polished but drift off the point, cite rulings that have nothing to do with the case and add work to proceedings that are already stretched.

The Zurich District Court said it could not yet see AI driving more cases, but legal laypeople were increasingly filing apparently AI-generated texts that were linguistically correct yet overly long, repetitive or poorly tailored to the case, sometimes with inaccurate references to case law. Processing effort can rise considerably, it said, particularly in time-critical family-law matters where extra urgent motions must be checked quickly. Courts in Bern, Aarau and Lucerne reported similar patterns.

...

At the Basel-Stadt civil court, president Patrik Müller said laypeople have turned to AI over roughly the past year and that pages-long statements now arrive even in simple ... With about 6,000 proceedings a year, he warned, the court’s ability to decide within a reasonable time is at risk.

# Велислава Делчева: Все повече институции получават жалби, изготвени с изкуствен интелект 

 14.10.2026 21:59 16884 

Велислава Делчева СНИМКА: Пресцентър на Омбудсмана на Република България 

Все повече държавни институции получават писма и жалби, изготвени с помощта на AI. Това заяви омбудсманът Велислава Делчева, като обясни, че самото използване на подобни инструменти от гражданите не е проблем. 

„Проблемът не е в това, че гражданите използват AI, за да изпращат жалби към институциите. По-големият проблем ще възникне тогава, когато институциите или частният бизнес започнат да използват AI, за да вземат решения, свързани с живота на гражданите", заяви омбудсманът по NOVA.

Pokud jí ale lidé přenechají celé zpracování podání bez následné kontroly, mohou vyřízení svého podnětu naopak prodloužit, upozorňuje úřad.

„Podání na ERÚ, ať už jde přímo o stížnost, ... Stačí srozumitelný popis situace vlastními slovy a přiložení veškeré relevantní dokumentace, ze které vyčteme podrobnosti,“ uvedla členka Rady ERÚ Markéta Zemanová.

...

ERÚ doporučuje používat AI především ke konzultaci nebo zpřesnění formulací a výsledný text vždy zkontrolovat. To platí také pro návrhy na rozhodnutí spotřebitelských sporů s dodavateli či zprostředkovateli. Ty na rozdíl od běžného podnětu musí splňovat zákonné náležitosti. AI může pomoci s jejich strukturou nebo kontrolou formální správnosti, zásadní ale zůstává popis okolností a doložení požadavků spotřebitele.

Институцията на омбудсмана получава жалби, написани с помощта на изкуствен интелект, които затрудняват работата на експертите. Документите са по 7-8 страници, съдържат множество въпроси по различни теми и изискват допълнително време, за да бъде установен конкретният проблем на подателя. Това съобщи омбудсманът Велислава Делчева пред журналисти по време на международна конференция за въздействието на изкуствения интелект върху основните права и ролята на правозащитните институции.

...

По думите ѝ изкуственият интелект вече е част от ежедневието и все по-често участва в процеси, които засягат основни права. Технологията може да влияе върху решения за отпускане на кредити, достъп до социална помощ и въпроси, свързани със здравето. Затова правозащитните институции трябва да познават рисковете и предизвикателствата, свързани с използването ѝ.

Gemeenten, ziekenhuizen en OV-bedrijven krijgen steeds vaker te maken met bezwaarschriften die met behulp van kunstmatige intelligentie (AI) zijn opgesteld. De teksten zijn doorgaans langer, juridischer en bevatten regelmatig onjuiste verwijzingen naar wetgeving. Dat zorgt voor extra werk en vertraging bij de afhandeling van bezwaren.

...

Volgens de gemeente Groningen zijn AI-gegenereerde bezwaarschriften vaak moeilijker te doorgronden. De teksten bevatten regelmatig argumenten die niet relevant zijn of verwijzen naar verkeerde wetgeving. 'In bezwaarschriften gegenereerd met AI is het vaak lastiger de bedoeling ervan te ontdekken omdat de tekst niet door een persoon geschreven is', zegt gemeentewoordvoerder Manon Hoiting. 

 De gemeente moet vervolgens wel op de aangevoerde argumenten reageren. Hoiting vergelijkt een gemiddeld AI-bezwaarschrift met 'een schot hagel', waarbij allerlei juridische gronden worden aangevoerd. Dat kost ambtenaren extra tijd.

...

Ook de gemeenten ... Volgens Westerkwartier zijn de teksten vaak 'wolliger, stelliger, langer en onduidelijker'. Het Hogeland ziet bovendien dat inwoners soms verwijzen naar jurisprudentie die helemaal niet bestaat.

Nous étions donc entre 6 000 et 6 500 requêtes par an. Puis, en 2024, 1 000 requêtes supplémentaires ! Nous nous sommes dit : il s’est passé quelque chose mais nous ne sommes pas des statisticiens ou des analystes de données… En 2025, plus de 8 500 requêtes ! Évidemment, sans plus de magistrats (28) et d’agents de greffe (25)… Et, cette année, nous nous dirigeons vers les 10 000…

Manifestement, c’est plurifactoriel. Mais l’une des données les plus visibles, c’est l’arrivée de l’IA. On le voit très clairement dans les requêtes.

> L’IA leur dit : « Mais vous avez tout à fait raison, cher Monsieur, vous êtes ans votre bon droit ». Ils ont le sentiment d’avoir le conseil d’un vrai juriste. Résultat, nous avons beaucoup d’hallucinations, on va nous inventer des références…

...

Une autre partie du surplus de requêtes ... Celles-là donnent lieu à un traitement accéléré et à un rejet sans même qu’il y ait d’audience.

Ein Verfahren am Sozialgericht dauert in Mitteldeutschland im Schnitt fast zwei Jahre. Vielen Betroffenen dauert das offenbar zu lange. Bei den Sozialgerichten in Sachsen, Sachsen-Anhalt und Thüringen landen immer mehr Eilanträge. Denn die müssen deutlich schneller bearbeitet werden, erklärt Hartwig Kasten, Präsident des Landessozialgerichts Sachsen-Anhalt. "Die meisten Entscheidungen wird man zwischen drei und sechs Monaten getroffen haben müssen. Es gibt auch Ausnahmefälle, dass sie da also in wenigen Tagen entscheiden müssen."

...

## Antragsflut

...

Bei den Sozialgerichten in Sachsen-Anhalt ist die Zahl dieser Eilanträge im ersten Halbjahr 2026 im Vergleich zum Vorjahrszeitraum um knapp 50 Prozent gestiegen. In Sachsen um etwa 120 Prozent und in Thüringen um mehr als 145 Prozent. Das ergab eine Umfrage von MDR AKTUELL bei den zuständigen Ministerien und Gerichten.

Dementsprechend erzeugt die gestiegene Zahl an Eilanträgen einen großen Mehraufwand bei den Gerichten, berichtet Kasten – auch beim Landessozialgericht Sachsen-Anhalt, dem er vorsteht. Bij ziekenhuis UMCG stapelen de AI-gegenereerde klachten en informatieverzoeken zich op. Dat uit zich bijvoorbeeld in het woordgebruik en de zinsconstructies, maar werkt ook door in de toon, zegt woordvoerder Joost Wessels. 'We merken vaak een relatief hardere, veeleisender toon, met meer nadruk dan voorheen op de verschillende rechten van de patiënt.'

events.context:
Am Bundesverwaltungsgericht gibt es eine Premiere: Erstmals verhängte das Gericht eine "Mutwillensstrafe" wegen KI-generierter Beschwerden. Das berichtet das Gericht in einer aktuellen Mitteilung auf seiner Website. Eine Person habe "binnen weniger Monate hunderte Seiten an offensichtlich KI-generierten Schriftsätzen und Beilagen abgegeben", heißt es. Die Dokumente hätten aus Sicht des Gerichts "weder Sinn ergeben noch den Streitgegenstand erklärt". Die Person muss nun eine Strafe in der Höhe von 200 Euro bezahlen.

...

Ausgangspunkt des Verfahrens, das nach wie vor anhängig ist, war ein Bescheid der Datenschutzbehörde. Die Person beschwerte sich bei Gericht gegen diesen Bescheid. "Um seinen rechtlichen Standpunkt zu untermauern, hatte der Beschwerdeführer binnen weniger als vier Monate insgesamt zwölf Stellungnahmen mit einer Vielzahl von Beilagen eingebracht, die zusammen hunderte Seiten umfassten. Bei Durchsicht der Eingaben stellte das Gericht fest, dass die Dokumente offensichtlich ausschließlich mit Hilfe von Textprogrammen (LLM) künstlicher Intelligenz erstellt worden waren", schreibt das Gericht.

...

Krajowa Administracja Skarbowa odnotowuje wyraźny wzrost liczby zażaleń w sprawach egzekucyjnych, które pełnomocnicy podatników przygotowują z pomocą sztucznej inteligencji. Mówił o tym szef KAS i wiceminister finansów Marcin Łoboda w wywiadzie dla PAP opublikowanym 7 października 2026 roku. Zjawisko zaczęło się według niego mniej więcej półtora roku temu. Odpowiedzią mają być własne narzędzia AI fiskusa, trenowane wyłącznie na danych resortu, a od 1 stycznia 2027 roku AI ma też wspierać analizę zdjęć RTG na przejściach granicznych.

...

Marcin Łoboda opisał zjawisko w wywiadzie dla Polskiej ... Według niego pełnomocnicy podatników składają liczne zażalenia na niektóre postanowienia, na razie dość proste. Szef KAS ocenił, że widać, iż pisma procesowe pisze sztuczna inteligencja, a w efekcie coraz częściej zaskarżane są czynności egzekucyjne.

...

Szef KAS nie podał liczb. Nie wiadomo, ile zażaleń wpływa obecnie, o ile wzrosła ich liczba i ile z nich organy uznały za zasadne. Ocena, że pisma przygotowała AI, opiera się na obserwacji urzędników, a nie na badaniu. Nie da się też stwierdzić, czy wzrost wynika wyłącznie z AI, czy także z wyższej liczby postępowań egzekucyjnych.

events.context:
Tekoälyllä tehty teksti voi jopa johtaa siihen, että

...

Kuluttajariitalautakunta muistuttaa, että yksinkertainen ja itse laadittu ratkaisupyyntö on useimmiten riittävä ja nopein keino ratkaisun saamiseksi.

Lautakunta kertoo verkkosivuillaan, että heille saapuu nykyään paljon tekoälyn avulla laadittuja ratkaisupyyntöjä ja muita viestejä.

”Tekoälyn tuottamat tekstit ovat usein tarpeettoman laajoja ja sisältävät asian käsittelyn kannalta epäolennaisia tai jopa virheellisiä seikkoja. Tämä hidastaa käsittelyä ja voi johtaa jopa asian käsittelemättä jättämiseen”, kuluttajariitalautakunnan verkkosivuilla kerrotaan.

Lautakunta muistuttaa, ettei ratkaisupyyntöön pidä lisätä oikeudellisia perusteluja tai lakiviittauksia, joita et ole itse tarkistanut. Tekoälyä ei pidä myöskään käyttää tapahtumien, vahinkojen, asiakirjojen tai kuvien keksimiseen tai muokkaamiseen.

Lautakunta ohjeistaa, että ratkaisupyynnössä on hyvä esittää selkeästi ja tiiviisti olennaiset tapahtumat, vaatimukset ja niiden perusteet.

Lautakunta katsoo, että tekoäly voi olla hyvä apu esimerkiksi tekstin selkeyttämiseen, tiivistämiseen ja kieliasun parantamiseen. Kuluttajariitalautakunta tiedotti asiasta kesäkuussa.

events.summary: A wave of highly precise, legally grounded complaints targeted the Ombudsman’s office in Plovdiv, Bulgaria, with citizens allegedly using AI to draft them. The complaints cite specific laws and resemble professional filings.
events.context:
Вълна от изключително прецизни и юридически издържани сигнали заля офиса на омбудсмана в Пловдив през последните месеци. Всички те са подредени по точки, цитират конкретни закони и използват професионална терминология, която обикновено е присъща на опитни адвокати или инженери.

Причината за тази необичайна промяна е масовото използване на изкуствен интелект от страна на гражданите, коментира Борислав Стаматов, информира Plovdiv24.bg. Той предупреждава, че макар дигиталният помощник да дава нови оръжия на хората срещу бюрокрацията, той крие и сериозни рискове.

...

Когато един официален отговор бъде анализиран от софтуер, всяко разминаване, пропуснат факт или липса на законно основание веднага

...

Въпреки безспорните ползи, инж. Борислав Стаматов съветва пловдивчани да бъдат изключително внимателни и да не разчитат изцяло на изкуствения интелект. Известно е, че алгоритмите понякога цитират отменени закони, бъркат компетентността на отделните институции или измислят несъществуващи факти, които звучат убедително.

Специалистът препоръчва всеки сигнал да бъде лично прегледан, проверен и допълнен с реалните детайли от конкретния случай, преди да бъде изпратен до съответните органи.

## Ένταση χρήσης τεχνητής νοημοσύνης για τη σύνταξη καταγγελιών

Η Αρχή έχει επίσης διαπιστώσει ότι αυξάνεται σημαντικά η χρήση εφαρμογών τεχνητής νοημοσύνης για τη σύνταξη καταγγελιών. Η χρήση των εργαλείων αυτών μπορεί να είναι χρήσιμη, ιδίως για την οργάνωση και τη διατύπωση ενός κειμένου. Ωστόσο, όταν το περιεχόμενο που παράγεται είναι εκτενές ή περιλαμβάνει ανακριβείς πληροφορίες, νομικά επιχειρήματα αμφίβολης εγκυρότητας ή περιπτώσεις «παραισθήσεων τεχνητής νοημοσύνης» (AI hallucinations), μπορεί να δυσχεράνει σημαντικά την αξιολόγηση και διερεύνηση της καταγγελίας, με κίνδυνο μάλιστα να «χαθεί» το κυρίως αντικείμενο αυτής ή να επιχειρείται να επιλύονται όλα τα ζητήματα ενός πολίτη μέσω επίκλησης της νομοθεσίας για την επεξεργασία των προσωπικών δεδομένων, ακόμα και σε περιπτώσεις που υφίσταται ειδικότερη νομοθεσία.

Η σαφής και συνοπτική περιγραφή των πραγματικών περιστατικών είναι, κατά κανόνα, πολύ πιο χρήσιμη για την αξιολόγηση μιας καταγγελίας.

A rede portuguesa de Arbitragem de Consumo, que integra os chamados tribunais de consumo (CIAB), deverá atingir este ano os 17 mil processos submetidos, mais cerca de seis mil do que em 2025, o que representa um aumento de cerca de 55%. Police deployed in large numbers to the scene as pupils were evacuated from the campus’s various buildings. They are being sheltered at the nearby De Bijloke music centre.

events.summary: AI-assisted agents are driving a surge in public-service requests.
events.context:
As AI makes it easier to fill forms and file complaints, public services around the world are seeing enormous jumps in applications and other requests. 

In the United Kingdom, complaints to the housing ombudsman more than doubled since the introduction of ChatGPT, rising from 2,600 in 2022 to just over 7,000 last year. The United States’ Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) saw 5x growth in complaints over the same period. There were similar jumps in Brazilian judicial petitions and German parliamentary petitions.

Researcher Chris Schmitz is tracking this rise as part of a broader trend he called “agentic flooding.” In a paper set to be presented next month at the AI Ethics and Society conference, he looks at 84 different cases of potential flooding across 11 jurisdictions, finding broad evidence that AI tools are changing the way people interact with public services.

...

For methodological reasons, Schmitz’s paper stops short of saying AI is directly causing the surge of new applicants. But most of the 84 cases follow the same basic arc, where submissions were roughly flat before 2022, then rose at increasing speed as AI technology diffuses. Crucially, most cases have

events.context:
Der Landesbeauftragte

...

Der Landesbeauftragte für den Datenschutz Niedersachsen (LfD), Denis Lehmkemper, hat dem Niedersächsischen Landtag seinen 31. Tätigkeitsbericht vorgelegt. Darin dokumentiert die Aufsichtsbehörde ihre Arbeit im Jahr 2025 und aktuelle Entwicklungen aus dem ersten Halbjahr 2026. Schwerpunkte bilden Künstliche Intelligenz, Cyber-Sicherheit und digitale Souveränität sowie die neuen Transparenzregeln für politische Werbung. Im Jahr 2025 gingen 4.022 Beschwerden beim LfD ein, rund 70 Prozent mehr als im Vorjahr. Der Anstieg setzte sich 2026 fort: Im ersten Halbjahr registrierte die Behörde rund 64 Prozent mehr als im Vorjahreszeitraum.

Auch die Zahl der gemeldeten Datenschutzverletzungen nahm zu. 2025 gingen fünf Prozent mehr als im Vorjahr, im ersten Halbjahr 2026 waren es rund 58 Prozent mehr als im entsprechenden Vorjahreszeitraum. Nach Einschätzung des LfD trägt auch Künstliche Intelligenz zu dieser Entwicklung bei. KI-Chatbots verwiesen bei der Suche nach möglichen Datenschutzverstößen häufig auf Beschwerdemöglichkeiten und erstellten entsprechende Musterschreiben. Både Konsumenternas Försäkringsbyrå och Allmänna reklamationsnämnden, ARN, har märkt av att kundklagomålen har förändrats på senare tid. 

Hos ARN har antalet ärenden på försäkringsavdelningen ökat med knappt 48 procent jämfört med samma period förra året (1 jan – 24 aug). Ökningen har skett på bred front och inom nästa alla försäkringskategorier, men framför allt inom villahem- och motorförsäkring samt reseförsäkring, djurförsäkring och olika former av inkomst- och låneskyddsförsäkringar. ”Vi har inga siffror på i vilken utsträckning anmälarna använder AI som stöd i processföringen, men intrycket är att det numera är relativt vanligt att AI används framför allt för den rättsliga argumentationen med varierande kvalitet”, uppger Martin Elfver som är jurist på ARN. 

Hos Konsumenternas Försäkringsbyrå säger vd Anna-Karin Baltzari-Danfors att mängden ärenden har minskat något eftersom konsumenter får svar på enklare frågor om försäkringar från AI. De mer komplicerade frågorna ställs dock fortfarande till Försäkringsbyrån, och även vid enklare frågor kan konsumenter höra av sig och stämma av om de fått rätt svar från AI.

"Mein Vater hat mir ein Darlehen gegeben, daraufhin hat das Jobcenter die Zahlungen gekürzt - Was kann ich dagegen tun?" Auf eine beispielhafte Frage wie diese antwortet Künstliche Intelligenz zunächst mit Handlungsratschlägen. Auf Wunsch liefert sie aber auch auf den ersten Blick gut formulierte Briefe ans Gericht. Zu oft rate sie zu Eilverfahren, zum Beispiel wenn es die Weiterzahlung von staatlichen Hilfsleistungen geht, sagt Mutschler - auch dann, wenn die Voraussetzungen gar nicht erfüllt sind.

Es sind die Eilverfahren, ... Dass sich Kläger die KI zu Hilfe holen, liege bei Sozialgerichtsfällen nahe, sagt er - weil hier keine Anwaltspflicht besteht. Für ihn aber sei die Arbeitsbelastung dadurch stark gestiegen.

events.context:
At the same time, such applications are increasingly found to be legally unfounded, contain inaccuracies, or are based on erroneous arguments.

PTAC notes: AI is capable of quickly preparing convincingly sounding text, however, it is not a legal consultant and does not bear responsibility for the information provided. Often, the user receives confirmation from AI that "the truth is on their side," even though the actual circumstances or legislation say otherwise.

As a result, people submit additional and repeated applications that do not help solve the problem but increase administrative burden.

AI can also refer to inappropriate or already outdated regulations, incorrectly specify procedural deadlines, or prepare legally incorrect claims for an enterprise or court.

Such mistakes can have real consequences - missed deadlines, unfounded demands, and unnecessary financial expenses. PTAC emphasizes: it is impossible to hold AI accountable for incorrect advice; the responsibility for the decision made remains with the user.

The center recommends using artificial intelligence only as an auxiliary tool and to always verify the information obtained from official sources or consult

events.context: … ctorat: valul de petiții redactate cu AI pune presiune pe școlile din Timiș # ChatGPT a ajuns la inspectorat: valul de petiții redactate cu AI pune presiune pe școlile din Timiș Foto Profimedia de Ozana Mazilu Publicat 24.04.2026 10:32 Inteligența artificială nu mai este doar un instrument pentru teme, rezumate sau mesaje scrise mai elegant. În Timiș, tehnologia a intrat și în relația dintre cetățeni și sistemul de educație, iar efectele încep să se vadă clar în activitatea instituțiilor. Inspectoratul Școlar Județean Timiș se confruntă, în această perioadă, cu o creștere puternică a numărului de petiții, multe dintre ele având o structură aproape identică și fiind suspectate că au fost redactate cu ajutorul unor aplicații de inteligență artificială. Fenomenul spune multe despre felul în care AI schimbă deja viața administrativă de zi cu zi. Dacă până nu demult formularea unei sesizări oficiale putea fi o barieră serioasă pentru mulți părinți sau profesori, acum aceeași operațiune a devenit mult mai simplă. Cu câteva instrucțiuni introduse într-un chatbot, o nemulțumire poate fi transformată rapid într-un text coerent, bine structurat și cu aparență formală. Pentru cei care trimit petițiile, acest lucru înseamnă acces mai ușor la dialogul …

events.summary: ERR reports that Estonia’s District Prosecutor's Office for Economic Crime and Corruption is overwhelmed by AI-generated criminal complaints and needs tools to process large volumes of data.
events.context: … ion handled an increasing number of sanctions-related offenses. Regardless of the field, however, criminal schemes are becoming more complex and the volume of case materials continues to grow, leading district prosecutor Sirle Melk said. To prevent the workload from becoming unmanageable, swift decisions are needed on which tools the public sector is permitted to use for processing large volumes of data, she noted. "There is an urgent need for tools with which to work through these materials. There has been a very strong surge in AI — we are already seeing in our work extremely lengthy criminal complaints generated by artificial intelligence to which we must respond, yet we do not have access to comparable tools ourselves. This already puts us at a disadvantage," Melk said. Estonia must very quickly adopt a clear position on how artificial intelligence tools should be approached in the public sector and what kinds of debates are needed: to what extent their use should be allowed, as well as to address increasingly pressing data protection issues, she added. events.context: … lamist threat is just a cover. - There may be a state actor behind it all, applying hybrid warfare. - Both Russian and Ukrainian traces can be identified in the operations, but Moscow is the only one with a strong motive. 23 January will be a memorable date in Hungary. There was no mass disaster, no natural calamity, no violent crime that shook the whole country, yet the lives of many were disrupted when students were evacuated from their schools all over the country due to a mass bomb threat.
